articles.title: Races for District Judges JP Contested
articles.excerpt: A Temple lawyer, he announced his candidacy for the open seat at an August 2023 campaign kickoff, describing a practice that covered civil matters including contracts, personal injury, trusts and estates, torts, real estate, employment and family law (Killeen Daily Herald).

articles.title: Voters Decide on Bell County Judges While JP Race Heads to Runoff
articles.excerpt: In the March 5, 2024 Republican primary he led Ashley Clapper Bennett with about 63% of the vote in election-night returns, and he said his Child Protective Services experience would apply to the CPS cases heard by the 146th (KDH).

articles.title: Retiring Bell County Judges Jones Gauntt Recognized
articles.excerpt: He took office Jan. 2, 2025, succeeding Judge Jack Jones, who retired Dec. 31, 2024 (KDH).

articles.title: Bell County Rings in New Year by Swearing in Elected Officials
articles.excerpt: He was among the county officials sworn in at the Bell County Justice Center at the start of 2025, with a Bell County Bar Association investiture set for Jan. 10 (KDH).
